$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：太陰獨坐巳亥，《深造講義》p.50。

basis.quote: 须注意其发射性与收敛性二者

rules.text: 你的太陰化祿：這份內斂是性格上的沉潛，不事浮誇。
rules.en: Your Tai Yin is transformed by Lu: this restraint is depth of character, without showiness.

source.quote: 前者仅为性格上的沉潜，不事浮夸

rules.text: 你的太陰化忌：內斂容易變成工於心計、耍手段；把想法說出來，比放在心裡盤算好。
rules.en: Your Tai Yin is transformed by Ji: restraint can turn into scheming and manoeuvring; saying what you think works better than calculating in private.

rules.text: 發揮較重的太陰，就算見吉星，也多是虛名：名聲大過實際，人生容易感到空虛。
rules.en: A Tai Yin that leans towards display tends, even with favourable stars, towards an empty name: reputation outruns substance, and life can feel hollow.
